# Verified Record Cards

Updated: 2026-07-02

Mission: Convert pulled records into reusable proof cards for the tracker system.

Boundary: A verified record card proves only the record it describes. It does not prove guilt, motive, knowledge, conspiracy, passenger identity, hidden control, or wrongdoing beyond the record text.

## Card Fields

- Record ID
- Title
- Source type
- Source route
- Record date
- Pulled date
- Evidence grade
- Tracker feeds
- Record shows
- Record does not show
- Claims supported
- Claims not supported
- Next record to pull
- Confidence impact
- Boundary

## Rule

A verified record proves only what it says. If a stronger claim is needed, pull another source and create another verified record card.

Use `data/verified-record-cards.json` for the full structured card data.
